package.name: usv_control_bridge
package.description: M5: cmd_vel → dual-PID → differential thrust bridge for the WAM-V (VRX sim). Subscribes to /cmd_vel_smoothed (Nav2 velocity smoother output), closes surge and yaw PID loops against /odometry/filtered, and publishes Float64 thrust commands to the WAM-V H-config thrusters.
